title: OSACT4 Shared Task on Offensive Language Detection: Intensive Preprocessing-Based Approach
findings: The paper does not present its own findings on religion but cites previous studies (Albadi, Kurdi, & Mishra, 2018) which found that for religious minorities in the Middle East such as Jews, Atheists, and Shia, almost half of the tweets mentioning them contained hate speech.
